deepseek.data_note: OpenCode Zen: zero-retention, no training on the data.

routing_policy.note: Owner instruction 2026-10-16: Step 5 Preview left the live Zen catalog. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free on OpenCode Zen) at native variant max is the default and only active OpenCode executor for every lane (/oc, /assure, /ro-review, the launcher, the opencode-subagent MCP and every OpenCode subagent). No variant below high is ever configured; max is the pin. Every earlier executor is retired and removed from this registry; its history stays in Git and in the dated records. The Token Harbor profile deepseek-th (lane /oc-th) was retired 2026-10-16 by Owner instruction (balance exhausted, no top-up); /oc stays on Zen.
routing_policy.selection_authority: Every run pins the deepseek profile explicitly (Zen, default; /oc, /assure, /ro-review). There is no second profile and no automatic fallback.

resolution_policy.note: One logical executor profile (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash). deepseek resolves only after live pinned-CLI catalog inspection of Zen (single admitted id must be listed, else fail closed). No cross-family substitute, no fallback between providers.

cross_executor_review_policy.note: MATERIAL implementation workstreams require a fresh-context READ-ONLY DeepSeek V4.1 Flash MAX review of the exact validated implementation SHA and TREE before PR_READY or COMPLETE. Only the top-level read-only /ro-review lane (foundry-reviewer) can carry verifiable review evidence; a writable top-level run or a subagent it dispatches never satisfies the gate. While DeepSeek is the only ACTIVE profile the implementation executor is also DeepSeek, so the review is same-model and its independence rests on the fresh context and read-only lane alone (review_independence); if a second profile is ever ACTIVE, same-model self-review is refused. A later generated-state-only checkpoint may be NON_MATERIAL and preserves the reviewed validated implementation identity without claiming the later state commit was reviewed. Self-review is refused only when an ACTIVE profile of a different model_family exists.
